files.test_files.py:
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from files import read_text

class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_escape(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            base = os.path.join(d, "base")
            os.mkdir(base)
            secret = os.path.join(d, "secret.txt")
            with open(secret, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write("secret")
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                read_text(base, "../secret.txt")
    def test_inside(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            base = os.path.join(d, "base")
            os.mkdir(base)
            p = os.path.join(base, "ok.txt")
            with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write("ok")
            self.assertEqual(read_text(base, "ok.txt"), "ok")

import unittest
from queue import pop_max

class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_max(self):
        items = [3, 1, 5]
        self.assertEqual(pop_max(items), 5)
        self.assertEqual(items, [3, 1])

gold.queue.py:
def pop_max(items):
    value = max(items)
    items.remove(value)
    return value

negative.queue.py:
def pop_max(items):
    value = min(items)
    items.remove(value)
    return value
